raylib:function:IsImageValid.scope: Returns the owner and raylib's validity verdict: positive dimensions and a format. Factory, decoder and loader owners always pass; hand-built records additionally need dimensions 1..4096, a format 1..13 and that format's storage variant (Words or Quads).

raylib:function:CompressData.scope: Immutable byte lists of 0..1048576 bytes with at most 87380 retained sequences per 262144-byte block. Invalid requests or sequence-budget exhaustion return None. The public decoder accepts compressed results only up to its separate 1 MiB input cap.

raylib:function:ComputeSHA256.scope: Immutable byte lists of 0..1048576 bytes; exactly eight native-order U32 hash words with native schedules/rounds and the native dataSize+4 padding rule, preserving its nonstandard digests at lengths 56..59 modulo 64. Invalid inputs return None before allocation.

raylib:function:ComputeCRC32.scope: Immutable byte lists of 0..1048576 bytes; native CRC32 initial/final complements over the shared PNG CRC recurrence, equal to standard CRC32. Unsupported bytes/lengths return None.

raylib:function:ComputeMD5.scope: Immutable byte lists of 0..1048576 bytes, including empty input. Native little-endian padding/message words, modulo-U32 rounds and exactly four U32 words in native array order (standard MD5). Unsupported bytes/lengths return None before allocation.

raylib:function:GetColor.scope: Packed 0xRRGGBBAA U32 words in GetColor byte order; Color.red/green/blue/alpha extract 8-bit channels.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ColorToInt.scope: Packs four channels as 0xRRGGBBAA keeping the low eight bits of each (C unsigned-byte conversion), the unsigned bit pattern of ColorToInt.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ColorAlphaBlend.scope: Integer ColorAlphaBlend on packed RGBA, including 256-based tint and alpha rounding.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ImageDrawLineV.scope: Every Surface format, each covered pixel stored with ImageDrawPixel's per-format encoding; bounded finite Vector2 inputs and raylib add-half/truncate rounding. Every format 1..13 is compared with raylib on the surface-format profile.

raylib:function:ImageDrawTriangleLines.scope: Every Surface format, each covered pixel stored with ImageDrawPixel's per-format encoding; bounded finite vertices truncated before line rasterization. Every format 1..13 is compared with raylib on the surface-format profile.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ImageDraw.scope: Formats 1..13; bounded finite source/destination rectangles, including fractional fields; source clipping precedes truncated-size scaling decisions; scaled sources are extracted and resized in their own format; destination clipping precedes pixel truncation. Pixels use GetPixelColor (integer packed expansion, R32 replicated), ColorAlphaBlend unless the source has no alpha and tint.a is 255, and SetPixelColor (no-op for R32/R32G32B32); unblended equal formats copy stored samples. An R32G32B32 source needs finite [0,1] samples (OutOfDomain). Both owners preserved; one mip level.

raylib:function:ImageFromImage.scope: Every Surface format; positive integral in-bounds regions; original owner retained and extracted storage independent with exact samples. Every format 1..13 is compared with raylib on the surface-format profile.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ImageCrop.scope: Every Surface format; integral crops with positive clipped results or native strictly-outside-origin no-ops; exact samples and returned owners on rejection. Every format 1..13 is compared with raylib on the surface-format profile.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ImageResizeNN.scope: Any Surface format via LoadImageColors, the plus-one fixed-point mapping and ImageFormat back, dimensions 1..4096; unsafe mappings return the original owner. R32G32B32 samples outside [0,1] return OutOfDomain with the owner. Every format 1..13 is compared with raylib on the surface-format profile.
gaps: Full input/format domain and all applicable platform/performance gates remain open.

raylib:function:ImageResize.scope: Formats 1..13; dimensions 1..4096. R8G8B8A8 uses the alpha-weighted 7-channel filter; GRAYSCALE, GRAY_ALPHA and R8G8B8 use the unweighted, unscaled 1..3-channel stbir layouts on their own bytes; formats 3, 5, 6, 8 and 9 go through LoadImageColors/ImageFormat and quantize even at unchanged sizes. Default Catmull-Rom/Mitchell filters retain binary64 normalization, clamp folding, per-layout pass-order costs and native SIMD accumulation order. Rejected requests preserve original owners; every format is compared on the surface-format profile and formats 1, 2 and 4 on the resize layout corpus.
gaps: Dimensions beyond the initial Surface domain
